title: RunEvent
description: A runtime event emitted during task execution. RunEvent is used in the Operations run ledger. event_type is extensible. sequence is used for append-only ledger ordering.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run this event belongs to.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task this event relates to.

event_type.description: Type of the event. Core types: 'started', 'progress', 'blocked', 'error', 'completed', 'artifact_produced', 'context_retrieved', 'approval_requested', 'handoff'. Extensible — consumers must ignore unknown event types.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent or runner that emitted this event.

payload.description: Structured event payload. Content depends on event_type. Must be a JSON object.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number for append-only ledger ordering within a run.
